samples.name: @mistralai/mistralai 0.0.7
samples.reason: BENIGN: genuine versioned Mistral SDK; caller-triggered API authentication and npm-publish CI match its stated purpose.
samples.behavior: Module load imports Axios and axios-retry and defines MistralClient. Construction saves caller key/endpoint, defaults the key from MISTRAL_API_KEY, initializes UTF-8 TextDecoder, and installs three-attempt retry handling for 429/5xx. listModels performs GET; chat/chatStream/embeddings POST caller inputs to the configured endpoint. _request uses Bearer authentication and returns response data. Streaming decodes chunks and JSON-parses data lines until [DONE], without eval or command dispatch. Examples request cheese advice. CI installs/lints source and writes the npm token into .npmrc for tag-gated publishing, rather than reading/exfiltrating that credential file.
samples.external_label_assessment: Secret-like environment access, authenticated HTTP, CI token writing, and the engine axios-retry prefix heuristic may resemble malware features. Their traced destinations/triggers support normal SDK and release behavior. The source of the external malware label remains unknown.
added_findings: Notable default UTF-8 TextDecoder initialization on client.js and its archive parent.
